scope: Case-02 k=1e-4 fixed-plane elastic 2Tv CPU/GPU delivery, under the user's Oct16 provisional 1D acceptance
findings: CPU/GPU full histories and requested profiles overlay; actual times and initial native material coordinates are used.
Late mean pressure keeps decaying; the log-scale historical comparison exposes the old float plateau without claiming a single-factor comparison.
Top material settlement error is about -0.417 percent; old HG and new settlement errors are similar in absolute scale, not a new order-of-magnitude gain.
Local Q still grows to about 10 Pa. Total-stress residual stays below the original 100-Pa guard; this does not prove absence of every mode.
Bottom material settlement is not bottom-wall drift: independent continuum comparison gives about 0.000927 mm excess for the first material layer.
15-s half-step evidence only; full-cycle CPU/GPU agreement is not full-cycle time convergence or validation for plasticity, large rotation or complex walls.
